name: hcapp_setEmailAndNotificationPrefs
description: Sets email alert and/or push notification preferences for a Hasher at either kennel scope (HasherKennelMap) or event scope (HasherEventMap). Requires exactly one of @kennelId or @eventId; both null is a validation error. A preference value of -1 means 'do not change' and is normalised to NULL before any write. For event-scoped rows, a value of 0 means 'inherit from kennel' and is stored as NULL in HasherEventMap. Upserts the relevant map row then delegates to HC6.hcapp_syncUserData. Note: no authorisation check on @hasherId — any authenticated user can change any other user's preferences.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for authentication.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic token validated against the device secret.

parameters.name: hasherId
parameters.description: Target Hasher whose preferences are updated. Defaults to the calling user (@userId) when NULL or the zero UUID.

parameters.name: emailPreference
parameters.description: New email alert preference. -1 = do not change (normalised to NULL). 0 in event-scoped path = inherit from kennel (stored as NULL in HasherEventMap).
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter is INT; table column is SMALLINT in both HasherKennelMap and HasherEventMap. No overflow guard in the SP.

parameters.name: notificationPreference
parameters.description: New push notification preference. -1 = do not change (normalised to NULL). 0 in event-scoped path = inherit from kennel (stored as NULL in HasherEventMap).
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter is INT; table column is SMALLINT in both HasherKennelMap and HasherEventMap. No overflow guard in the SP.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel scope. Resolved automatically from HC.Event when @eventId is provided and @kennelId is NULL.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event scope. When provided, the preference upsert targets HasherEventMap instead of HasherKennelMap.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark passed through to HC6.hcapp_syncUserData. Defaults to 'ignore' when NULL.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark passed through to HC6.hcapp_syncUserData. Defaults to 'ignore' when NULL.

rowsets.name: WriteEnvelope
rowsets.description: Standard HC6 write SP success envelope. Always present as the first rowset.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. Error code on failure (e.g. 1214 for missing scope, 1914 for unhandled DB error).

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. Error classification: 11=auth, 12=param/validation, 19=db (CATCH block).

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Present only on failure (success=0). Returns structured error detail for the client.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: UUID of the HC.ErrorLog entry written for this failure.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Same errorType code as in the WriteEnvelope rowset.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Same errorCode as in the WriteEnvelope rowset.

columns.name: errorProc
columns.description: Name of the SP that raised the error, via OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID).

rowsets.name: PrefsResult
rowsets.description: Present only on success. Returns the effective (post-write) preference values for immediate UI update.

columns.name: adHocDataId
columns.description: Always 1. Identifies this rowset as adHoc data to the client.

columns.name: notificationPreference
columns.description: Effective notification preference after the write. For event scope, resolves COALESCE(event pref, kennel pref).

columns.name: emailAlertPreference
columns.description: Effective email alert preference after the write. For event scope, resolves COALESCE(event pref, kennel pref).

rowsets.name: SyncUserDataRowsets
rowsets.description: Present only on success. Zero or more rowsets returned by HC6.hcapp_syncUserData — HasherEventMap and HasherKennelMap delta sync results. Structure is defined by that SP.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.HasherKennelMap — when @eventId is null/zero and no existing HKM row for (@hasherId, @kennelId)
UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap — when @eventId is null/zero and an HKM row already exists
INSERT HC.HasherEventMap — when @eventId is provided and no existing HEM row for (@hasherId, @eventId)
UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap — when @eventId is provided and an HEM row already exists
INSERT HC.ErrorLog — on any validation or unhandled error
EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncUserData — always on success, outside the main transaction

codeSmells.detail: @hasherId can be any Hasher UUID. The SP does not verify that the calling user (@userId) is the same as @hasherId or is an admin. Any authenticated user can silently change notification preferences for any other user.

codeSmells.issue: INT parameters assigned to SMALLINT columns without overflow guard
codeSmells.detail: @emailPreference and @notificationPreference are declared INT, but HasherKennelMap.KennelEmailAlertPreference, HasherKennelMap.KennelNotificationPreference, HasherEventMap.EventEmailAlertPreference, and HasherEventMap.EventNotificationPreference are all SMALLINT. SQL Server will silently truncate or raise an arithmetic overflow if an out-of-range value is supplied.

codeSmells.issue: Asymmetric zero-semantics between kennel-scoped and event-scoped paths
codeSmells.detail: For HKM: @emailPreference=0 is stored as 0 in the column. For HEM: @emailPreference=0 means 'inherit from kennel' and is stored as NULL. The same input value has different meanings depending on scope, which is undocumented in the parameter itself and a likely source of client-side bugs.

codeSmells.issue: syncUserData runs outside the main TRY/CATCH
codeSmells.detail: HC6.hcapp_syncUserData is called after COMMIT and after the END CATCH block. Any failure in that EXEC will propagate as an unhandled exception. Callers may receive a partial result (WriteEnvelope + PrefsResult) followed by a fatal error from the sync SP with no clean error envelope.

codeSmells.issue: Zero-UUID sentinel for @hasherId handled inconsistently with @kennelId/@eventId
codeSmells.detail: @hasherId is normalised from the zero UUID to NULL (then to @userId) at the top of the SP. @kennelId and @eventId are normalised to NULL only after the missing-scope validation guard, meaning a zero UUID for either is also caught by the guard — but only incidentally. The logic is correct but fragile.

breakingChanges: Transaction added around the upsert operations — HC5 had no TRY/CATCH and no transaction, so the write was non-atomic.
Auth failure now returns errorType=11 via HC6.ValidateAppAuth. HC5 returned errorType=3 (a bug — 3 is the HC5 portal 'not found' code, not an auth code).
syncUserData delegation target changed from HC5.hcapp_syncUserData to HC6.hcapp_syncUserData.
Zero UUID is now treated as NULL for @hasherId, @kennelId, and @eventId. HC5 may have passed zero UUIDs through to queries.
